name: pixie
description: A magical fairy companion that brightens dark caves, sniffs out buried ores, warns you of approaching monsters, and rescues you from fatal blows.

scripts.i18n:update: npm run i18n:extract && for f in locale/*.po; do [ -f "$f" ] && msgmerge -U --backup=none "$f" locale/pixie.pot; done
scripts.i18n:check: for f in locale/*.po; do [ -f "$f" ] && msgfmt -c -v -o /dev/null "$f"; done
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:update && npm run i18n:check

author: SaKeL
